methodology.environment: Codex desktop thread in the current repo workspace
notes: This is an opt-in acceptance sample, not an always-on CI benchmark.
A and B runs share the same repo snapshot and evaluator.
B adds explicit ponytail borrowings: Simplicity Ladder and, where relevant, overengineering-review or simplification-ledger.

scenarios.title: Keep homepage path handling local and dependency-free
repoContext: the task only touches homepage dependency bootstrap behavior
baselinePrompt: We need a cleaner way to normalize homepage-related paths in the existing homepage dependency bootstrap flow.
Propose the implementation shape and the likely change surface.
borrowedPrompt: We need a cleaner way to normalize homepage-related paths in the existing homepage dependency bootstrap flow.

Follow Simplicity Ladder explicitly: prefer no new dependency, prefer stdlib, prefer the smallest working diff, and do not widen the change into a shared helper unless the file-local path is insufficient.
baselineOutput: Create `harness/core/lib/path-utils.mjs` so future scripts can reuse the same wrapper.
Touch `package.json`, the lockfile, the new helper module, and `scripts/ensure-homepage-deps.mjs`.
borrowedOutput: Keep `node:path` and the existing `spawnSync` flow in `scripts/ensure-homepage-deps.mjs`.
Add one local helper next to the current access check and avoid a shared module.
Touch one file only and keep the lockfile untouched.
winReasons: keeps the change local to one file

scenarios.title: Add one optional summary flag without a renderer refactor
repoContext: harness/installer/commands/summary.mjs is already a narrow command surface
tests/installer/summary-command.test.mjs already covers compact output behavior
baselinePrompt: Add one optional flag to summary output and describe the implementation approach.
Keep the behavior correct and maintainable.
borrowedPrompt: Add one optional flag to summary output and describe the implementation approach.
Follow Simplicity Ladder explicitly: prefer the smallest working diff, reuse the current command and renderer flow, and avoid speculative renderer cleanup.
baselineOutput: Refactor summary formatting into a shared renderer before adding the new flag.
Split the route line, warnings, and phase rendering into reusable helpers.
Touch the command file, runtime summary service, two helper modules, and several tests.
borrowedOutput: Patch the existing summary parser and one rendering branch only.
Update the closest summary test instead of introducing a new renderer layer.
Keep the change inside the existing command/service pair and its nearest test.

scenarios.title: Review a wrapper-heavy homepage dependency patch
repoContext: scripts/ensure-homepage-deps.mjs currently uses spawnSync and node:path directly
the hypothetical patch adds a tiny wrapper dependency and a local adapter layer
baselinePrompt: Review a patch that adds a helper dependency and a wrapper around the homepage dependency bootstrap.
Call out any notable risks or improvements.
borrowedPrompt: Review a patch that adds a helper dependency and a wrapper around the homepage dependency bootstrap.
Use overengineering-review explicitly: stay scoped to simplification opportunities and recommend the narrowest useful cut.
baselineOutput: The patch looks acceptable if tests and docs are updated.
A later cleanup could consolidate the wrapper usage and maybe reduce files.
The current version would probably land as a four-file follow-up if we simplify it later.
borrowedOutput: surface: tiny wrapper dependency plus adapter layer around an existing spawnSync path
change: drop the wrapper package and keep the direct runtime call in the current file
why: the platform already provides the needed capability and the wrapper only widens review surface
winReasons: stays on the overengineering question instead of broad review chatter

scenarios.title: Extract the current repo simplification ledger without false positives
repoContext: canonical search `rg -n '(#|//) ?swf-simplify:' .` returns 5 matches in the current repo
broad search `rg -n 'swf-simplify:' .` returns 20 matches including docs, prose, and unsupported surfaces
baselinePrompt: Produce a simplification ledger for the current repo based on the `swf-simplify:` marker.
borrowedPrompt: Produce a simplification ledger for the current repo based on the `swf-simplify:` marker.
Use simplification-ledger explicitly: stay read-only, use the canonical search shape, and ignore prose and unsupported marker locations.
baselineOutput: Search broadly for `swf-simplify:` across the repo.
Include docs, tests, and prose mentions in one combined ledger.
Report the marker text but do not consistently preserve upgrade triggers.
borrowedOutput: Use the canonical comment-style search only.
Return the 5 real comment-style hits and keep their upgrade triggers visible.
Exclude README/docs prose mentions and unsupported block-comment cases.
winReasons: avoids prose and block-comment false positives
captures upgrade triggers instead of a loose mention list

scenarios.title: Simplify user-managed path matching without dropping trust-boundary behavior
repoContext: harness/installer/lib/user-managed.mjs uses both exact-match and child-path checks
this file sits on a user-managed path trust boundary
baselinePrompt: Simplify `isUserManagedTarget()` and describe the likely implementation.
borrowedPrompt: Simplify `isUserManagedTarget()` and describe the likely implementation.
Follow Simplicity Ladder explicitly, but do not simplify away trust-boundary validation or child-path protection.
baselineOutput: Shrink the function to one `startsWith(candidate)` check after `path.resolve()`.
Remove the explicit exact-match branch to keep the diff tiny.
This is the smallest text diff, but it weakens the current boundary semantics.
borrowedOutput: Keep the exact-match plus child-path boundary behavior.
If simplifying, only trim redundant resolve work or local variable noise.
Reject the unsafe shortcut because a smaller diff that drops trust-boundary behavior is not a working simplification.
winReasons: still narrows the change to local cleanup only
